Use case: style-transfer. Repaint IMAGE 5 ONLY: the existing 天剑诛魔·云阳 card. PRESERVE ITS ORIGINAL COMPOSITION AND CAMERA EXACTLY. Same landscape aspect ratio and original staging. Image5 is the COMPOSITION/EDIT TARGET. Images1/2/3 are PAINT STYLE ONLY, image4 is Wu IDENTITY ONLY.

ORIGINAL COMPOSITION INVARIANTS: one immense VERTICAL GOLD-WHITE summoned sword in the center of the frame, blade pointing downward, a broad flat ochre-gold vertical strip behind it, and flat deep navy panels on BOTH sides. Same sword size, shape, crossguard and central location. Wu stands inside the central strip at the same scale, most of her figure visible; her FACE stays on the VIEWER'S LEFT of the bright central blade, completely readable. Her raised arm is on the VIEWER'S RIGHT, with open bare hand lifted next to/above the giant sword crossguard. Her OTHER bare hand stays low on the VIEWER'S LEFT, holding the small black-gray physical sword downward. Silver-white straight high ponytail streams toward the RIGHT, as in the target; short skirt flares sideways with a single narrow blue-star hem band. Preserve exact overall person placement, gesture, sword/person overlap, wide blank navy side panels and light column width. DO NOT introduce a diagonal slash, lunge, kneeling pose, two-handed grip, demons, extra swords or alternate camera. The earlier action-redesign is superseded by the user's explicit request to follow the original layout.
Wu / 无: adult anime woman, bright cyan-blue eyes, silver-white hair in a LONG STRAIGHT HIGH PONYTAIL to about hip level, plain straight blunt bangs with both eyes visible, black round goggles resting on forehead, one BLACK ROSE and cobalt-blue ribbon at the HIGH PONYTAIL ROOT. Short black-gray OFF-SHOULDER dress with LONG loose sleeves reaching wrists, a few roughly grouped ruffle shapes, gathered wrist cuffs. Front/back/side skirt hems ALL equally short ending ABOVE KNEES, no train; ONE narrow blue STAR band ONLY along skirt hem, no blue stars on bodice or sleeves. Bare hands, bare thighs, black ankle boots. Simple thin BLACK/CHARCOAL held sword, small straight rectangular guard and dark grip, neutral gray metal accents. No blue physical blade, gloves, armor, staff or extra jewelry. Concentrated confident face, slight smile with one tiny fang if mouth visible. Preserve reference identity, change pose.

Paint this SAME scene with dramatically fewer details and larger broad handmade marks. The gold-white central sword remains a simple readable flat icon-like shape, NOT a glossy realistic blade or glowing particle effect. Background maintains the original pure navy/ochre abstract solid-color blocks. Identity stays readable; the black physical sword has neutral gray accents, no blue glow. No scenery, horizon, architectural environment, sky, particles or environmental entities.
CRITICAL FINISH: ROUGH HAND-PAINTED ANIME COLOR STUDY, visibly loose and unfinished, deliberately far LESS DETAILED than reference figures. Think a quick expressive broad-brush gouache sketch that stops when the large shapes read, not a polished rendered painting. Most marks are LARGE opaque blunt dabs or LONG wide swipes that each describe an entire hair lock or cloth plane. A dominant base color plus one broad shadow and a few uneven paint strokes per region. Quiet color interiors greatly outnumber textured areas. Leave a few visible loose construction/contour lines, small unfilled edge gaps and off-register overlaps. Coarse connected shape rhythm with irregular handmade boundaries. DO NOT turn roughness into tiny chips, grain, canvas texture, hundreds of scratches or random noise. Hair is 4–6 broad coherent locks with ONE broad pale highlight patch per grouped area, NO strands or fine contour network. Dress is a few large near-black shapes with 3–5 broad cool-gray fold strokes, NOT individually drawn ruffles or dense creases. Face stays unmistakably anime but SIMPLE: clear blue irises with one highlight each, bold upper eyelid strokes, one nose mark, one mouth mark, one cheek/under-jaw shadow shape. No tiny iris detail, polished lips, sculpted skin shading or beauty rendering. Hands and weapons readable with economical strokes. No elaborate sword guards, ornamental blade etching, gold filigree, complex jewelry, metallic reflections or all-over finishing. Matte muted color masses with local color accents. Mostly hard grouped shadows; no smooth gradients, airbrush, cinematic glow, volumetric light or glossy 3D. Visible purposeful broad paintwork, simplified anatomy and convincing motion. NO text, watermark, logo, UI, cards within cards or collage.
